questions.cardText:
[Linguistics] What does the Greek prefix “meta-” originally mean?
A. After
B. Transcend
C. Intangible
Answer: A. It can also mean “behind.”
questions.de: Was bedeutet die griechische Präposition hinter der Vorsilbe „meta-“ üblicherweise – der Sinn, der Aristoteles' Metaphysik ihren Namen gab?
questions.en: What does the Greek preposition behind the prefix “meta-” typically mean — the sense that gave Aristotle's Metaphysics its name?

timeline.labelEn: Andronicus of Rhodes edits Aristotle's works and names the Metaphysics, the book “after the Physics”
timeline.labelDe: Andronikos von Rhodos ordnet Aristoteles' Werke und benennt die Metaphysik, das Buch „nach der Physik“

questions.notes: Card confirmed: μετά typically means 'after', 'beside', 'with' or 'among' (other senses 'beyond', 'adjacent', 'self'). Timeline: Andronicus fl. c. 60 BC (Wikipedia, Andronicus of Rhodes).

questions.cardText:
[Physics] If you throw a pie from Canada to Mexico, how would the Coriolis effect affect where it lands?
A. To the right of where you aim
B. To the left of where you aim
C. Closer than where you aim
Answer: A. Imagine throwing a pie from the center of a spinning playground roundabout that rotates counterclockwise. The pie will land to the right of your aim on the roundabout. Similarly, due to the Earth’s counterclockwise rotation (when viewed from the North Pole), your airborne pie will be deflected to the right. This effect influences many things including the weather patterns (e.g., trade winds) and the aiming of snipers.
questions.de: Zu welcher Seite seiner Bewegungsrichtung lenkt die Corioliskraft auf der Nordhalbkugel einen bewegten Körper ab, etwa eine von Kanada nach Mexiko geworfene Torte?
questions.en: In the Northern Hemisphere, to which side of its direction of travel does the Coriolis effect deflect a moving object, such as a pie thrown from Canada towards Mexico?

timeline.labelEn: Gaspard-Gustave de Coriolis publishes the paper describing the force named after him
timeline.labelDe: Gaspard-Gustave de Coriolis veröffentlicht die Arbeit, die die nach ihm benannte Kraft beschreibt

questions.notes: Card confirmed: objects moving on Earth are deflected to the right in the Northern Hemisphere (to the left in the Southern).
